shortDescription: Celebrate Festivus on December 23 with Seinfeld Trivia at Charter 803. Bring your team for a night of Costanza family chaos and classic moments from the show.
description: It's a Festivus for the rest of us! Join Four Dogs Entertainment at Charter 803 for Seinfeld Trivia on December 23, the actual date of Festivus. Bring your team and test your knowledge of Jerry, George, Elaine, Kramer, the Costanzas, the Airing of Grievances, the Feats of Strength, and plenty of unforgettable moments from the show.
